report.honestyTitle: Automated scan — manual checks still recommended
report.honestyBody: This audit targets WCAG 2.2 Level {level} using automated rules (axe-core), which catch roughly 30–50% of issues. It does not replace human review of things like meaningful alt-text quality, logical reading/focus order, keyboard traps, captions, and cognitive clarity. Use it to fix the clear failures fast, then review the rest manually.
